items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: The interviewee Ernie Cagnolatti does not speak in the provided transcript. The mention of Adolf Alexander is made by the Interviewer, who states 'he started carrying Adolf Alexander on alto'. There is no evidence in the text that Ernie Cagnolatti personally knew, met, or collaborated with Adolf Ale

ctx.x: You all playing tonight? Can't you come play

with me tonight? You know, like that. You turned your house down and you couldn't make it. And I said, ma'am, that is Cherie. That is the man of presence. Yeah, and later on, later on when Tio left then he started carrying Adolf Alexander on alto and then a Cherie on tenor. Sometime at a Cherie he would play his E-flat clarinet. Sometime he felt like it.
